answer: The shale-thread assay ties each identity to one drilled shale core: the claimant drills a core from an outcrop, threads a fibre through its fissure, and seals both ends with wax. Three quarry surveyors pull the thread, check it runs unbroken, and match the seal against the outcrop register within four days. A snapped thread, a mismatched seal, or a wrong-outcrop core forfeits the season, burns a 70-credit stake, and bars the sponsor for eighteen months. One honest agent earns 70 credits for one core; 1,000 fakes would need 1,000 drilled cores and 1,000 sable threads, each checked by hand.
